purpose: Empirical requirements audit; not new model extraction, historical-edge admission or a benchmark score.

scope.sampling: Purposive coverage of distinct experimental changes, not exhaustive or statistically representative.
scope.limits: Targeted passages and record inspection, not every full paper and supplement. Baseline descriptions may come from the later authors; do not promote them to independently verified ancestry.

cases.baseline: CEL-Seq and explicitly identified intermediate adaptations
cases.observed_change: Second-adapter addition by ligation is replaced by an adapter-bearing random RT primer; other optimizations include primer design, enzymes and cleanup.
cases.retained: Early cell indexing and IVT-based amplification remain part of the method family.
cases.required_description: Compare the route that produces an adapter-bearing library, including the primer structure and removed ligation. Final-library identity or operation labels alone can miss the distinction.
cases.locator: Results: CEL-Seq2 is optimized for higher sensitivity; Ligation-free library preparation improves read mapping; Fig.1
cases.source_level: Primary full article page, targeted Results passages; supplementary experiments not independently re-audited.
cases.history_status: Later authors explicitly describe a modification of CEL-Seq. Original predecessor paper not independently reread in this audit; not an admitted edge.
cases.negative_control: Do not attribute the complete assay sensitivity gain to adapter-route replacement alone; do not call the paper's comparison to Smart-Seq inheritance.

cases.baseline: The CLIP/iCLIP implementations described in the irCLIP paper
cases.observed_change: A dye/biotin-bearing RNA adapter supports infrared visualization and affinity handling. Nuclease digestion is assessed on captured material rather than only in lysate; recovery and RT processing also change.
cases.retained: UV-crosslinked protein-RNA selection and RNA-derived cDNA library generation.
cases.required_description: Record adapter molecular features and the operations that use them; separately record substrate context/order and recovery changes. An adapter State alone does not explain its downstream uses.
cases.locator: Registered primary b00004,b00006,b00007,b00009 and Methods; source pin in current_records.
cases.source_level: Registered primary full text; targeted Results/Methods plus current extracted State properties and Operations.
cases.history_status: Specific cited implementations and imported components require separate claims. No new historical edge admitted in this audit.
cases.negative_control: Do not equate infrared QC with sequencing; do not treat the dye and biotin as having the same function; do not attribute all gains to one feature.

cases.baseline: CLIP approaches described as losing RT-truncated cDNA
cases.observed_change: Library construction recovers RT-truncated cDNA using circularization/linearization; endpoint interpretation uses these products, and random sequence tags help distinguish PCR duplicates.
cases.retained: Crosslinking and protein-directed enrichment of RNA.
cases.required_description: Link residual crosslinked material, RT truncation, retained cDNA products, library topology and the endpoint-to-contact interpretation. This is a connected path, not a single changed node.
cases.source_level: Registered primary full text; targeted introduction, discussion, methods and Fig.1 caption.
cases.history_status: Later paper describes CLIP limitations. No independently admitted predecessor attribution from this requirements audit.
cases.negative_control: Do not label every RT stop a biological contact, claim collision-free molecular identifiers, or describe a circular intermediate as the final sequenced library.

cases.baseline: Direct strand joining in CLASH, as compared in the hiCLIP paper
cases.observed_change: An adapter is inserted between joined RNA arms; adapter end processing gates the second ligation and the separator helps identify the two arms in hybrid reads.
cases.retained: Recovering RNA duplex information through joined RNA products.
cases.required_description: Record end chemistry, joining order, junction architecture and how two read segments map to RNA origins. A generic ligation correspondence is insufficient.
cases.locator: Registered primary b00004,b00005; current deblock/join/map operations.
cases.source_level: Registered primary full text; targeted introduction/results and current extraction.
cases.history_status: CLASH comparison and iCLIP-derived portions must be assessed separately; not a whole-assay ancestry assertion.
cases.negative_control: Do not infer common mechanism or interchangeability from the word ligation; do not force comparison to mean development.

cases.baseline: NAI/SHAPE probing without the same purification handle
cases.observed_change: An azide-bearing SHAPE reagent permits subsequent biotin attachment and enrichment of modified RNA-associated cDNA, with a matched background branch.
cases.retained: Chemical reactivity is related to RNA flexibility and observed through reverse transcription.
cases.required_description: Track which molecule bears the adduct/biotin, its association with cDNA, capture/release, and the treated-versus-control interpretation.
cases.locator: Registered primary b00007,b00008,b00009; primary protocol PMID26766114 and current treated/mock extraction.
cases.source_level: Registered primary full texts; targeted design passages and State/Operation records.
cases.history_status: Design requirements example; individual precursor chemistry contributions still require citation review.
cases.negative_control: Biotin on RNA is not copied into cDNA during RT. The control branch must not be assumed to carry the same chemical mark as the treated branch.

cases.baseline: Conventional adapter-ligation workflows that do not recover the relevant blocked RNA ends
cases.observed_change: Differential end reactivity is used for selection before repair makes surviving target ends ligatable.
cases.retained: Adapter-mediated conversion of selected RNA into a sequenceable cDNA library.
cases.required_description: Record original end class, ordered end transformations, resulting ligation competence, and known alternative end chemistries that can pass selection.
cases.locator: Registered primary b00009,b00011,b00017; corrected current extraction.
cases.source_level: Registered protocol full text; targeted chemistry and limitations passages.
cases.history_status: Capability/selection example; conventional RNA-seq is not a uniquely resolved predecessor.
cases.negative_control: Periodate resistance is not exclusive proof of cP: the paper names 2-prime-O-methylated ends as confounders. Three depicted chemical classes are not three physically separated fractions.

cases.baseline: Two alternative implementations of joint DNA/RNA measurement from a cell
cases.observed_change: DR-seq co-amplifies before splitting; G&T-seq separates RNA and genomic DNA before separate processing.
cases.retained: Same-cell genome/transcriptome association is the common measurement objective.
cases.required_description: Record which material is together at each point, the actual split/separation, processing order, branch-specific outputs and how matched-cell identity survives.
cases.locator: DR-seq registered primary b00004,b00006; G&T-seq abstract and Illumina source-grounded extraction.
cases.source_level: DR-seq primary full text; G&T-seq primary abstract only in current registry. G&T detailed route follows its reviewed depiction; no new full-method validation claimed.
cases.history_status: Correspondence/alternative comparison only. No inheritance asserted between these methods.
cases.negative_control: Same measurement objective is not a common material route or ancestry. Two branches must not be collapsed into an all-to-all derivation.

cases.baseline: Affinity-isolation-based detection of metabolically labeled RNA described in the paper
cases.observed_change: Alkylation makes incorporated 4-thiouridine detectable through a characteristic sequencing substitution pattern, enabling analysis within total RNA.
cases.retained: Metabolic labeling during a time interval.
cases.required_description: Connect the original RNA mark to chemical processing, the resulting cDNA/read signature and the inference about synthesis during labeling. The mark is not an exact molecular birth timestamp.
cases.locator: Introduction; Results: Detection of 4-thiouridine by sequencing; Fig.1 and Fig.2.
cases.source_level: Primary full article page; targeted introduction and Results. No new local workflow extraction.
cases.history_status: Specific labeling, chemistry and library contributors are separate citation questions. No direct ancestry asserted merely from a shared metabolic label.
cases.negative_control: Do not describe RNA base alkylation as physically converting the RNA base into cytosine. Separate molecular chemistry from the read substitution signature.

cases.observed_change: The paper reports improvements in bead preparation, array indexing and library generation rather than a single changed transcript-capture node.
cases.required_description: Represent the barcode-to-coordinate map as required data and keep array manufacture/indexing distinct from processing tissue on the array. A library alone does not identify spatial positions.
cases.locator: Abstract and indexed primary introduction/array-generation passages.
cases.source_level: Primary indexed abstract and passages accessible; direct article opening hit a browser challenge. No claim of full-paper/supplement review.
cases.history_status: Authors explicitly identify an updated Slide-seq method. Two-sided detailed version/feature adjudication not performed here.
cases.negative_control: Smaller spatial units do not by themselves establish cell identity; map accuracy and molecule recovery are separate properties.

validation: All local case operation/state anchors resolve to the exact pinned current extraction; this checks addressing only.
